instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Once upon a time, Goldilocks was walking in a forest and saw a house. She went inside.

There were three bowls of porridge on the table. She was very hungry. The first bowl of porridge was too hot, the second was too cold, but the last was just right. She ate it all.

Then, Goldilocks saw three armchairs, and wanted to sit down.

The first chair was too big, the second was too small, but the last chair was just right.

But all of a sudden, the chair broke!

atoms.a: Why didn’t Goldilocks like the first bowl of porridge?
Which chair was the right size?

instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.title: Goldilocks and the Three Bears — Part 2

atoms.text:
Goldilocks was tired now. She went upstairs and saw three beds. The first was too lumpy, the second was too soft, but the third was just right. She quickly fell asleep.

Soon, the bears came home.

“Someone’s been eating my porridge!” said Daddy Bear.
“Someone’s been eating my porridge!” said Mummy Bear.
“Someone’s been eating my porridge — and it’s all gone!” cried Baby Bear.

Then they saw the chairs.

“Someone’s been sitting in my chair!” said Daddy Bear.
“Someone’s been sitting in my chair!” said Mummy Bear.
“Someone’s been sitting in my chair — and it’s broken!” cried Baby Bear.

atoms.a: What did Goldilocks do on the comfortable bed?
b: She jumped up and down on it.
None of the beds were comfortable.

instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.title: Goldilocks and the Three Bears — Part 3

atoms.text:
Finally, the bears went upstairs.

“Someone’s been sleeping in my bed!” said Daddy Bear.
“Someone’s been sleeping in my bed!” said Mummy Bear.
“Someone’s been sleeping in my bed — and she’s still there!” cried Baby Bear.

Goldilocks woke up and saw the three bears. She screamed, ran downstairs and into the forest. She never came back to the house.

atoms.a: Whose bed was Goldilocks sleeping in?
What two things did Goldilocks do when she saw the bears?
What is the main message of the story?
b: ++Respect people’s privacy and don’t go into people’s homes.
Make sure your mattresses are comfy.
